name: TenuVault
description: TenuVault is a desktop app for Windows and macOS that backs up, compares and restores Microsoft Intune configuration. It signs in as you through an app registration in your own tenant, so no third-party service holds your tenant data. A backup covers more than 40 Intune object types with their assignments, from Settings Catalog, compliance and endpoint security policies to scripts and enrollment profiles. Conditional Access policies can be included. Backups are encrypted on your device, or go to your own Azure storage on Pro and MSP. TenuVault also shows what changed between two backups, detects configuration drift, and deploys and validates OpenIntuneBaseline. The free Community plan covers one tenant with weekly backups and restores single items as unassigned copies. Pro and MSP add daily schedules, restore in place with assignments, drift revert and CIS Benchmark assessments, and MSP restores into other tenants. Made by the maintainer of Awesome Intune.
author: Ugur Koc
